_comment: SC2 shader families backed by sc2_shaders/sc2_shaders.slang. Each family shares one original .fx across both stages (unlike wc3_shaders' per-stage entries). `vs`/`ps` map the fx entry point + slang entry point + the BLS bundle basename. The per-stage permutation set (and its decoded b_* axes) comes from sc2_perms/<Family>_<stage>.json (the cache-order manifest), not from perm_count here â€” perm_count is a cross-check. See docs/SC2_SHADERS_MODULE_DESIGN.md / SC2_SHADERS_IMPLEMENTATION.md.

Model._comment_ps: DefaultPixelMain shared by Model/Particle/Ribbon/Foliage; M1 covers the standard shading mode incrementally. perm_count is the retail PS set from the manifest.
Model._comment_vs: ModelVertexMain is Model-specific (the four Default families share only the PIXEL root). The VS permutation set decodes from the SAME family schema as the PS (sc2_family_decode.decode_default_vs) plus b_iBlendWeightCount.

Foliage._comment_vs: FoliageVertexMain: compressed vertex stream, fixed Input layout (none of the b_iLayoutHas* axes apply). Shares the Default-family transport/lighting/GenUV bodies. Its section table is the shared one shifted by -8 bits (sc2_family_decode.FAMILY_SECTION_SHIFT).
Foliage._comment_ps: Foliage has NO dedicated PS entry â€” foliage.fx uses the shared DefaultPixelMain (slang model_ps_main), same as Model/Ribbon/Particle; only its VS differs. Validated in M2.2. Its own PS perm set + bundle name are what make this a distinct entry.

Ribbon._comment_vs: RibbonVertexMain: GPU ribbon simulation. b_iRibbonSimTech reshapes VertDecl (SPLINE collapses the stream to position/uv/offset/batch; LEGACY adds the prev/next trail samples). The family's own 23-bit axis header sits at key bit 104 (sc2_family_decode.FAMILY_OWN_AXES, read from Ribbon_BuildFamily), which is what puts its shared sections at +16.
Ribbon._comment_ps: Ribbon has NO dedicated PS entry â€” ribbon.fx uses the shared DefaultPixelMain (slang model_ps_main). Validated in M2.2 (its few excluded slots are fxc rejecting the ORIGINAL .fx at high b_iSoftShadowTaps, not slang defects).

Particle._comment_vs: ParticleVertexMain: point-to-quad expansion. Its Input is UNPERMUTED (like Foliage) but carries true integer attributes (int4 vSize/vRotation, int2 vOffset, uint4 iBatchIndex). b_iInstanceType (11 values) picks the quad basis. Own 18-bit axis header at key bit 104; shared sections at +16. The only root that reads b_UVRandomOffsetEnable[].
Particle._comment_ps: Particle has NO dedicated PS entry â€” particle.fx uses the shared DefaultPixelMain (slang model_ps_main). Validated in M2.2 (excluded slots are fxc rejecting the ORIGINAL .fx, not slang defects).

SplatDirect._comment_ps: SplatDirectPixelMain: stencil-fill wrapper over DefaultPixelMain (own axis b_stencilFillPass). Model PS schema; validated bit-exact in M2.3.
SplatDirect._comment_vs: SplatDirectVertexMain (M5): own ROOT on the SHARED transport. Same family schema as the PS (own axis b_stencilFillPass@104 + Model's sections, minus VertexWarp -- splatdirect.fx includes neither VSVertexWarp.fx nor VSSkinning.fx). SPLAT_VERTEX_FORMAT makes vBlendIndices a true uint4, and it indexes the per-splat uniform arrays through p_fBatchIndexRemappingTable -- both pinned by VS_INPUT_DOMAINS / VS_CONST_DOMAINS.

SplatDeferred._comment_ps: SplatDeferredPixelMain: depth-reconstruction box-render preamble over DefaultPixelMain (3 own axes). Validated bit-exact in M2.3.
SplatDeferred._comment_vs: SplatDeferredVertexMain (M5): own ROOT on the SHARED transport, position+normal stream only. Same family schema as the PS; none of its three own axes reaches the vertex closure. Every retail VS perm has b_iUVEmitterCount=0 and b_iLayoutHasColor=0 -- the latter matters, because the original's HasColor_ block reads a cColor its SplatVertIn does not declare.

TerrainBlend._comment_ps: TerrainBlendPixelMain: own-IO terrain/projector texture blending (own schema â€” 3 axes + Common, 9 blend modes). Validated bit-exact in M2.3. inject_preamble=false: terrainblend.fx declares its OWN `VertexTransport` struct, so the shared gen_preamble transport must NOT be injected into the reference compile (it would collide).
TerrainBlend._comment_vs: TerrainBlendVertexMain (M5): own IO on both stages, so inject_preamble=false here too. Its 9 perms are exactly the 9 blend modes; only b_iTerrainBlendMode reaches the vertex closure.

Water._comment_ps: WaterPixelMain: own-root PS reusing the shared transport + body stack (own schema â€” 5 axes + Common/Lighting/FOW). env/cheap/pretty branches. Validated bit-exact in M2.
Water._comment_vs: WaterVertexMain (M5): own ROOT on the SHARED transport. Same family schema as the PS. The Gerstner wave loop is bounded by the CONSTANT p_fNumWaveVectors.x, so VS_CONST_DOMAINS pins it to a legal wave-table index; b_iCheapWater skips the waves entirely (and packs Normal/Tangent out).

RenderPlane._comment: M4 self-contained. NO own axes; links [FOW, Common] in that order (RenderPlane_BuildSection @0x102b66420). Own VertexTransport -> inject_preamble false.

MinimapTerrain._comment: M4 self-contained. Own axes b_showMap@104, b_iScaleAlphaToTerrain@105; NO linked sub-sections (MinimapTerrain_BuildSection @0x102b5e430) -- its 4 perms are the 2x2.

LensFlare._comment: M4 self-contained. Own axis b_shaderMode@104; links [Common, FOW] (LensFlare_BuildSection @0x102b53f90). Own VertexTransport -> inject_preamble false.

Flash._comment: M4 self-contained. Own axes b_iVertexShader@104 w3 (card 5) + b_iPixelShader@107 w4 (card 14); NO linked sub-sections (Flash_BuildSection @0x102b490a0). Retail: 5 VS perms, 14 PS perms -- exactly the cardinalities. Own vertex format -> inject_preamble false.

HDR._comment: M4 self-contained. Ten own axes @104 (b_iHDRPass..b_iOperator), NO linked sub-sections (HDR_BuildSection @0x102b52c40). Own VertexOutput -> inject_preamble false; hdr.fx still calls the zero-arg InitShader(), which sc2_interp.gen_initshader_stub supplies to the reference leg.

Image._comment: M4 self-contained. Nine own axes @104 + Common (Image_BuildSection @0x102b53510). b_iLayerCount sizes the PS composite, b_iVertexLayoutLayerCount the vertex STREAM (always the wider of the two). Own SImageVtxFmt -> inject_preamble false. PS_CONST_DOMAINS pins p_vLayerAlphaChannelIndex to [0,4) (it selects a channel of the sample).

Bokeh._comment: M4 self-contained. One own axis b_iBokehPass@104 w3 + Common (Bokeh_BuildSection @0x102b46a50); 7 passes x 3 encodings = the 21 retail PS perms. PREPASS..MEDIAN write two targets. Own VertexTransport -> inject_preamble false.

DeferredLight._comment: M4 self-contained SCHEMA but SHARED transport: 5 own axes @104 + [Common, Lighting] (DeferredLight_BuildSection @0x102b480f0). Unlike the other M4 families it calls InitShader/WRITE_INTERPOLANT_*, so inject_preamble stays TRUE and it is in sc2_shaders_cfg._SHARED_TRANSPORT. Live set is {ScreenPos} or {BackBufferUV, ScreenPos}. b_iStereoscopicCorrection is registered by no section (dead source, constant 0).

PostProcessQuad._comment: M4, the big one: 36 own axes spanning 79 bits + [Common] at 184 (PostProcessQuad_BuildSection @0x102b63770). 15 modes (copy/blur/downscale/CoC/DOF/SSAO/gradient/depth-encode/screen-particle/FXAA/FOW/halo x3). Own ROOT on the SHARED transport (InitShader + UV/GaussianBlurSample/DownscaleUV0,1/ScreenPos), so inject_preamble stays TRUE and it is in _SHARED_TRANSPORT. The ONLY root that makes GaussianBlurSample live -- sc2_interp.gen_preamble grew that array interpolant for it.
